notes: Neutral herald angel (planned AP-001, a series with no gameplay card yet, so testBed only means 'no card'). The first angel in the pipeline; her Prime still wears the iridescent pastel bikini of the original test-bed outfit. Hair, eyes and skin are fixed like every other angel (champagne-blonde, light grey, fair warm-neutral) and forced at 1_Prime, with the build applied at 2_Bare. Palette (Soft Pearl White / Warm Champagne Gold / Dove Grey) is her wardrobe scheme. The free test-bed for any photo is alpha/female.
